method.source: WikiArt regular HTML page og:image; public size suffix removed to request the original image URL
method.verification: full decode verification followed by bounded JPEG draft decode; candidate thumbnail compared against local reference
method.decision_note: Accepted means the candidate passed automated source and image-match checks; it is not manual verification or an art-quality judgment. Mismatches and absent references remain unpromoted.
method.license_note: WikiArt page URLs are retained as provenance. Page HTML does not provide a reliable per-image license field in the metadata used by this pass.
